name: one point of light carries the idea across centuries
looks: A lone silhouetted figure raises a hand toward a single point of light in the sky. More figures join the line one at a time, a growing crowd, each era's word for that same light fading in above them in a different script, a thin progress bar along the bottom tracking the date forward from antiquity toward today. The point of light itself slowly becomes a falling star, then a rising moon, as a city skyline grows in beneath it.
build: Each new silhouette fades/steps into the line on a seeded stagger; each era's word-label cross-fades to the next, timed to the timeline bar's playhead, which advances with no easing from the clock (timeline-scrubber-hud's mechanic); the light's form morphs between states (point, streak, disc) as a crossfade tied to the same clock, so mark, word and bar always agree on where in history the scene sits.
sound: A sustained low drone under the whole sequence, a soft chime each time a new word-label lands.
prompt: Let a single point of light persist across many cuts while the world around it changes: more silhouettes joining a line reaching toward it, each era's own word for it fading in above in a different script, a thin timeline bar along the bottom tracking the date, and the light itself slowly changing form, so one mark carries the idea continuously through centuries of jump cuts.
